messages:
maya: quick heads-up — profiler shows OOM spike on rtx-pool when continuous-batching grows >24. padding blowout on short sequences, OOMs up ~3x
kevin: can you paste the snapshot/logs?
maya: here's the top of the alloc snapshot from the run
```
alloc_snapshot:
  active_workspace: 6.2GB
  kv_cache: 2.1GB
  pad_waste: 1.8GB
  transient_tmp: 0.6GB
  peak_rss: 9.5GB
```
sanjay: looks like kernel-selector v2 is picking a fused kernel that needs bigger aligned workspace for small seqs — transient_tmp is the giveaway
lia: fwiw we rolled kernel-selector v2 to rtx-pool yesterday to improve latency for short tch runs, but didn't fully account for alignment padding in allocator sizing
infra-bot: deploy: kernel-selector v2 -> rtx-pool (2026-03-15T22:04Z) :rocket:
kevin: short term mitigation: introduce deferred_alloc for ephemeral temporaries + stricter slab reuse thresholds. propose config: 
```
allocator:
  deferred_allocation: true
  deferred_timeout_ms: 10
  slab_reuse_threshold: 0.6
  workspace_watermark: 0.75
```
maya: deferred_alloc would avoid the transient bump at step boundaries — yes please. also we need per-seq pad_waste telemetry so we can attribute which seq lengths cause the blowout
sanjay: agree. another quick fix: cap continuous-batch growth to 24 sequences while we iterate on allocator heuristics. that reduces pad amplification for mixed-length workloads
lia: also add an eviction hint to KV cache to prefer evicting older unpinned prefixes instead of prefix entries that would trigger re-materialization during the same batch
kevin: will run a replay with deferred_alloc config + batch_cap=24. need the replay id from you, maya
maya: replay id replay-20260315-09. captured on rtx-pool, includes mixed short/long seqs
kevin: thx, launching experiment now. will push telemetry changes (per_seq.pad_waste tag) to staging first
infra-bot: incident created: INC-4722 (oom-regression-rtx)
maya: action items: 1) kevin run replay+deferred_alloc 2) sanjay prototype per-seq pad_waste metric 3) lia rollback kernel-selector v2 on rtx-pool if OOMs persist 4) I'll gather logs and flamegraphs
kevin: +1, aiming to have results by EOD tomorrow
sanjay: I can spike a fast allocator test harness to simulate slab reuse thresholds and workspace_watermark, should have numbers in 24h
lia: will prepare rollback playbook and notify oncall
maya: thanks all, keeping thread here for updates :thumbsup:
